targets.label_scope: object and location binding from public evidence

targets.allowed_public_tool: paired public get_sales_report(days=1,by_product=false,location=...) then get_sales_report(days=1,by_product=true,location=...) on same pre-call business day
targets.report_day_binding: first public daily report supplies explicit day/date and totals; second public by-product report supplies product aggregate; totals, location and same-day coverage must agree; post-call trailing clock never labels either body
targets.missing_product: 0 only if complete coverage and stable alias; otherwise UNKNOWN
targets.intervention_changed: CENSORED or new issuance; never retroactively edit frozen prediction
targets.truth_limit: realized sales, not latent demand or causal price elasticity
targets.reference: pre-issuance same-target and scope public realized-unit mean; unavailable baseline means unpaired
targets.coverage: both public reports complete and consistent, stable canonical product alias, same completed-day window; otherwise UNKNOWN
targets.complete_coverage: both actual paid-time public reads succeed for the same day and location, totals reconcile, product alias is stable; otherwise UNKNOWN

publication: at least 4 unique common future events across >=2 day clusters; offspring vs parent and baseline; do not inherit birth event or validation scores
